translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
suaad ,   qasam hai naseehat bharay Quran ki ,
kay jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , woh kissi aur wajeh say nahi , balkay iss liye apnaya hai kay woh barai kay ghamand aur hatt dharami mein mubtala hain .
aur unn say pehlay hum ney kitni qoamon ko halak kiya , to unhon ney uss waqt aawazen den jab chutkaray ka waqt raha hi nahi tha .
aur inn ( quraish kay ) logon  ko iss baat per taajjub huwa hai kay inn/unn kay paas aik khabrdar kernay wala unhi mein say aagaya . aur inn kafiron ney yeh keh diya kay :  woh jhoota jadoogar hai .
kiya uss ney saray maboodon ko aik hi mabood mein tabdeel kerdiya hai ? yeh to bari ajeeb baat hai .
aur unn mein kay sardar log yeh keh ker chaltay banay kay :  chalo , aur apney khudaon ( ki ibadat ) per dattay raho yeh baat to aesi hai kay iss kay peechay kuch aur hi iraday hain .
hum ney to yeh baat pichlay deen mein kabhi nahi suni . aur kuch nahi , yeh mann gharrat baat hai .

kiya yeh naseehat ki baat hum sabb ko chorr ker issi shaks per nazil ki gaee hai ?  asal baat yeh hai kay yeh log meri naseehat kay baaray mein shak mein mubtala hain , balkay enhon ney abhi meray azab ka maza nahi chakha .
tumhara rab jo bara data , bara sahab-e-iqtidar hai , kiya uss ki rehmat kay saray khazaney inhi kay paas hain-?
ya phir aasmano aur zameen aur unn kay darmiyan her cheez ki badshahat inn kay qabazay mein hai ?   phir to enhen chahiye kay rassiyan taan ker oopper charh jayen .
. ( unn ki haqeeqat to yeh hai kay ) yeh mukhalif girohon ka aik lashkar saa hai jo yahin per shikast kha jaye ga .
inn say pehlay nooh ki qoam , qoam-e-aad aur meekhon walay firon ney bhi payghumberon ko jhutlaya tha ,
aur qoam-e-samood , aur loot ki qoam aur aieka walon ney bhi . woh thay mukhalif giroh kay log !
unn mein say koi aisa nahi tha jiss ney payghumberon ko naa jhutlaya ho , iss liye mera azab baja tor per nazil ho ker raha
aur ( makkah kay ) yeh log ( bhi ) bus aik aesi chinghaarr ka intizar ker rahey hain jiss mein koi waqfa nahi hoga .
aur kehtay hain kay :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! humara hissa hamen roz-e-hisab say pehlay hi jaldi deydey !

. ( aey payghumber ! ) yeh jo kuch kehtay hain , uss per sabar kero , aur humaray banday dawood ( aleh-assalam ) ko yaad kero jo baray taqatwar thay .   woh beyshak Allah say boht lo lagaye huye thay .
hum ney paharon ko iss kaam per laga diya tha kay woh shaam kay waqt aur sooraj kay nikaltay waqt unn kay sath tasbeeh kiya keren .
aur parindon ko bhi , jinhen ikattha kerliya jata tha . yeh sabb unn kay sath mil ker Allah ka khoob ziker kertay thay .
aur hum ney unn ki saltanat ko istehkaam bakhsha tha , aur unhen danai aur faisla kunn guftoogo ka saliqa ata kiya tha .
aur kiya tumhen unn muqadma walon ki khabar phonchi hai jab woh deewar per charh ker ibadat gaah mein ghuss aaye thay-?

jab woh dawood kay paas phonchay to dawood unn say ghabra gaye . unhon ney kaha :  dariye nahi , hum aik jhagray kay do fareeq hain , hum mein say aik ney doosray kay sath ziyadti ki hai . abb aap humaray darmiyan theek theek faisla ker-dijiye , aur ziyadti naa kijiye , aur hamen theek theek raasta bata dijiye .
yeh mera bhai hai . iss kay paas ninnanway dunbiyan hain , aur meray paas aik hi dunbi hai , abb yeh kehta hai kay woh bhi meray hawalay kero , aur iss ney zor-e-biyan say mujhay daba liya hai .

dawood ney kaha :  iss ney apni dunbiyon mein shamil kernay kay liye tumhari dunbi ka jo mutalba kiya hai , uss mein yaqeenan tum per zulm kiya hai . aur boht say log jinn kay darmiyan shirkat hoti hai , woh aik doosray kay sath ziyadti kertay hain , siwaye unn kay jo emaan laye hain , aur jinhon ney naik amal kiye hain , aur woh boht kam hain .  aur dawood ko khayal aaya kay hum ney darasal unn ki aazmaesh ki hai , iss liye unhon ney apney perwerdigar say moaafi maangi , jhuk ker sajday mein gir gaye , aur Allah say lo lagai .
chunacheh hum ney uss moamlay mein unhen moaafi dey di . aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay unn ko humaray paas khaas taqarrub hasil hai , aur behtareen thikana !

aey dawood ! hum ney tumhen zameen mein khalifa banaya hai , lehaza tum logon  kay darmiyan bar-haq faislay kero , aur nafsani khuwaish kay peechay naa chalo , werna woh tumhen Allah kay raastay say bhatka dey gi . yaqeen rakho kay jo log Allah kay raastay say bhatak jatay hain , unn kay liye sakht azab hai , kiyonkay unhon ney hisab kay din ko bhula diya tha .

aur hum ney aasman o zameen aur unn kay darmiyan jo cheezen hain unn ko fuzool hi peda nahi kerdiya . yeh to unn logon  ka gumaan hai jinhon ney kufr ikhtiyar kerliya hai , chunacheh unn kafiron kay liye dozakh ki shakal mein bari tabahi hai .

jo log emaan laye hain , aur jinhon ney naik amal kiye hain , kiya hum unn ko aesay logon  kay barabar kerden gay jo zameen mein fasad machatay hain-? ya hum perhezgaron ko bad-kaaron kay barabar kerden gay-?
. ( aey payghumber ! ) yeh aik ba-barkat kitab hai jo hum ney tum per iss liye utaari hai kay log iss ki aayaton per ghor-o-fiker keren , aur takay aqal rakhney walay naseehat hasil keren .
aur hum ney dawood ko suleman ( jaisa beta ) ata kiya , woh behtareen banday thay , waqaee woh Allah say khoob lo lagaye huye thay .
. ( woh aik yaadgaar waqt tha ) jab unn kay samney shaam kay waqt achi nasal kay umda ghorray paish kiye gaye ,
to unhon ney kaha :  mein ney iss dolat ki mohabbat apney perwerdigar ki yaad hi ki wajeh say ikhtiyar ki hai  yahan tak kay woh oat mein chup gaye .
. ( iss per unhon ney kaha : )  inn ko meray paas wapis ley aao , chunacheh woh ( unn ki ) pindliyon aur gardanon per haath pherney lagay .
aur yeh bhi waqiaa hai kay hum ney suleman ki aik aazmaesh ki thi , aur unn ki kursi per aik dharr laa ker daal diya tha ,   phir unhon ney ( Allah say ) rujoo kiya ,

kehney lagay kay :  meray perwerdigar ! meri bakhshish farma dey , aur mujhay aesi saltanat bakhsh dey jo meray baad kissi aur kay liye munasib naa ho .   beyshak teri , aur sirf teri hi zaat woh hai jo itni sakhi data hai .
chunacheh hum ney hawa ko unn kay qaboo mein kerdiya jo unn kay hukum say jahan woh chahtay humwaar ho ker chala kerti thi .
aur shareer jinnaat bhi unn kay qaboo mein dey diye thay , jinn mein her tarah kay meymaar aur ghota khor shamil thay .
aur kuch woh jinnaat jo zanjeeron mein jakray huye thay .
. ( aur unn say kaha tha kay : )  yeh humara atiya hai , abb tumhen ikhtiyar hai kay ehsan ker kay kissi ko kuch do , ya apney paas rakho , tum per kissi hisab ki zimma daari nahi hai .
aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay unn ko humaray paas khaas taqarrub hasil hai , aur behtareen thikana !
aur humaray banday Ayub ko yaad kero , jab unhon ney apney perwerdigar ko pukara tha kay :  shetan mujhay dukh aur azaar laga gaya hai .
. ( hum ney unn say kaha : )  apna paon zameen per maaro , lo ! yeh thanda paani hai nahaney kay liye bhi , aur peenay kay liye bhi .
aur ( iss tarah ) hum ney unhen unn kay ghar walay bhi ata kerdiye , aur unn kay sath utney hi aur bhi .   takay unn per humari rehmat ho , aur aqal walon kay liye aik yaadgaar naseehat .

aur ( hum ney unn say yeh bhi kaha kay : )  apney haath mein tinkon ka aik muttha lo , aur uss say maar do , aur apni qasam matt torro .    haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum ney unhen bara sabar kernay wala paya , woh behtareen banday thay , waqaee woh Allah say khoob lo lagaye huye thay .
aur humaray bandon Ibrahim , Ishaq aur Yaqoob ko yaad kero jo ( naik amal kernay walay ) haath aur ( dekhney wali ) aankhen rakhtay thay .
hum ney unhen aik khaas wasf kay liye chunn liya tha , jo ( aakhirat kay ) haqeeqi ghar ki yaad thi .
aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay humaray nazdeek woh chunay huye behtareen logon  mein say thay .
aur Ismail aur Al-Yasaa aur zulkifil   ko yaad kero . aur yeh sabb behtareen logon  mein say thay .
yeh sabb kuch aik naseehat ka paygham hai , aur yaqeen jano kay jo log taqwa ikhtiyar kertay hain , aakhri thikaney ki behtari unhi kay hissay mein aaye gi ,
yani hamesha basay rehney kay liye jannaten jinn kay darwazay unn kay liye poori tarah khulay hon gay !
jahan woh takiya lagaye huye boht say meway aur mashroobat mangwa rahey hon gay ,
aur unn kay paas woh hum umar khawateen hon gi jinn ki nigahen ( apney shohron per ) markooz hon gi .
yeh hai woh ( naimaton say bharpoor zindagi ) jiss ka tum say roz-e-hisab mein wada kiya gaya hai .
beyshak yeh humari ata hai jo kabhi khatam honey wali nahi .
aik taraf to yeh hai , aur ( doosri taraf ) jinn logon  ney sarkashi ikhtiyar ki hai , yaqeen jano , unn ka aakhri thikana boht bura hoga ,
yani dozakh jiss mein woh dakhil hon gay ! phir woh unn ka bad-tareen bistar banay gi .
yeh hai kholta huwa paani aur peep ! abb woh iss ka maza chaken ,
aur unn tarah tarah ki cheezon ka jo issi jaisi ( takleef deh ) hon gi .

. ( jab woh apney perokaaron ko aata dekhen gay to aik doosray say kahen gay : )  yeh aik aur lashkar hai jo tumharay sath ghusa chala aaraha hai , phitkaar ho inn per , yeh sabb aag mein jalney walay hain .
woh ( aaney walay ) kahen gay :  nahi , balkay phitkaar tum per ho , tum hi to yeh museebat humaray aagay laye ho , abb to yehi bad-tareen jagah hai jiss mein rehna hoga .
. ( phir woh Allah taalaa say kahen gay kay : )  aey humaray perwerdigar ! jo shaks bhi yeh museebat humaray aagay laya hai , ussay dozakh mein dugna azab dijiye .
aur woh ( aik doosray say ) kahen gay :  kiya baat hai kay hamen woh log ( yahan dozakh mein ) nazar nahi aarahey jinhen hum buray logon  mein shumar kertay thay ?
kiya hum ney unn ka ( nahaq ) mazaq uraya tha , ya unhen dekhney say nigahon ko ghalati lagg rahi hai-?
. yaqeenan dozakhiyon kay aapas mein jhagarrney ki yeh sari baaten bilkul sachi hain jo ho ker rahen gi .
. ( aey payghumber ! ) keh do kay :  mein to aik khabrdar kernay wala hun , aur uss Allah kay siwa koi ibadat kay laeeq nahi jo aik hai , jo sabb per ghalib hai ,
jo tamam aasmano aur zameen aur unn kay darmiyan her cheez ka malik hai , jiss ka iqtidar sabb per chaya huwa hai , jo boht bakhshney wala hai .
keh do kay :  yeh aik azeem haqeeqat ka izhar hai ,
jiss say tum mun morray huye ho ,
mujhay aalam-e-baala ki baaton ka kuch ilm nahi tha jab woh ( farishtay ) sawal jawab ker rahey thay .
meray paas wahi sirf iss liye aati hai kay mein saaf saaf khabrdar kernay wala hun .
yaad kero jab tumharay perwerdigar ney farishton say kaha kay mein garay say aik insan peda kernay wala hun ,
chunacheh jab mein ussay poori tarah bana dun aur uss mein apni rooh phoonk dun to tum uss kay aagay sajday mein gir jana .
phir huwa yeh kay saray kay saray farishton ney to sajda kiya ,
albatta iblees ney naa kiya , uss ney takabbur say kaam liya , aur kafiron mein shamil hogaya .

Allah ney kaha :  iblees ! jiss ko mein ney apney haathon say peda kiya , uss ko sajda kernay say tujhay kiss cheez ney roka hai-? kiya tu ney takabbur say kaam liya hai , ya tu koi boht oonchi hastiyon mein say hai ?
kehney laga :  mein iss ( Adam ) say behtar hun . tu ney mujhay aag say peda kiya hai , aur iss ko garay say peda kiya hai .
Allah ney farmaya kay :  acha to nikal jaa yahan say ! kiyonkay tu mardood hai ,
aur yaqeen jaan qayamat kay din tak tujh per meri phitkaar rahey gi .
uss ney kaha :  meray perwerdigar ! phir tu mujhay uss din tak kay liye ( jeenay ki ) mohlat deydey jiss din logon  ko dobara zinda kiya jaye ga .
Allah ney farmaya :  chal , tujhay unn logon  mein shamil kerliya gaya hai jinhen mohlat di jaye gi ,
. ( lekin ) aik mutayyan waqt kay din tak .
kehney laga :  bus to mein teri izzat ki qasam khata hun kay mein inn sabb ko behkaon ga ,
siwaye teray barguzida bandon kay .
Allah ney farmaya :  to phir sachi baat yeh hai , aur mein sachi baat hi kaha kerta hun ,
kay mein tujh say aur unn sabb say jo unn mein say teray peechay chalen gay , jahannum ko bhar ker rahun ga .
. ( aey payghumber ! logon  say ) keh do kay :  mein tum say iss ( Islam ki dawat ) per koi ujrat nahi maangta , aur naa mein banwati logon  mein say hun .
yeh to duniya jahan kay logon  kay liye bus aik naseehat hai ,
aur thoray say waqt kay baad tumhen iss ka haal maloom hojaye ga .
